questions.q: How does the XD5-40d's direct-thermal speed at 203 dpi compare to the Zebra ZD421?
questions.e: The XD5-40d tops out at ~7 ips (178 mm/s) DT vs the ZD421's ~6 ips (152 mm/s) — roughly 17% more throughput per shift.

questions.q: Which emulations let the XD5-40 drop into existing label workflows?
o: ZPL II, EPL and DPL (DPL optional)
None — it uses a proprietary language with no emulation
questions.e: Native SLCS plus ZPL II, EPL and DPL emulation means existing Zebra/Eltron/Datamax/Honeywell label formats carry over without a rewrite.

questions.q: At which IOR customer was the XD5-40 proven as a live Zebra drop-in?
o: Intact (driven from Intact Xline, direct-to-port ZPL)
It has never been tested at a customer
questions.e: On IOR's Rathnew bench the XD5-40 was driven live from Intact Xline, auto-sensed ZPL, and printed perfectly with zero configuration.
